blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion language models can write many tokens per step, but must choose which tokens are safe to commit together. Mean-field decoding penalizes pairs of positions whose predictions look alike. We replace this proxy with the coupling itself: how much committing one token changes the model's confidence at another. Cheap probes inside the main forward pass measure it, with no training or extra model, and it plugs into the same mean-field rule. On three models and four benchmarks, our method needs far fewer steps than mean-field decoding and is faster in most settings, also with a key-value cache, at an average accuracy cost of 1.1 points. Shuffling the couplings or replacing them with a uniform bonus loses this gain.
blocks.zh: 传播语言模型每步可以写许多符,但必须选择哪些符是安全的,可以共同承诺. 中场解码会惩罚一对位置,其预测是相同的. 我们用连结本身来代替这个代名词:一个符号的花费多少会改变模型对另一个符号的信心. 主前方的廉价探测器测量它,没有训练或额外的模型,它插进同样的中场规则. 在三个模型和四个基准上,我们的方法所需步骤远少于中场解码,在大多数设置中更快,也有键值缓存,平均精度成本为1.1分. 擦掉接合物或者用统一奖金来代替它们,就失去了这一收益.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2023 ; Comanici et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) write text one token at a time.
Each new token needs a full forward pass, so the time to answer grows with the length of the answer.
Discrete diffusion language models ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Nie et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) offer a parallel alternative.
They treat generation as iterative denoising: the answer starts fully masked, and every step can fill in several positions at once.
Recent models scale this idea to strong, large systems ( Bie et al., 2025 ; Bie et al., 2026 ) , which makes fast parallel decoding a practical goal.

他们把世代视为迭代去名:答案开始被完全掩盖,每个步骤可以同时填补几个职位.
最近的模型将这个想法放大到强大的大型系统 (Bie等,2025;Bie等,2026),这使得快速并列解码成为实用目标.

blocks.en:
The hard part is deciding which tokens to commit together.
A diffusion model predicts every masked position independently, from the same context.
Two tokens can each look certain on their own and still form a wrong pair, because neither was predicted with the other in view ( Ringel et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Confidence thresholds commit only positions whose top prediction is very likely ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
Dependency-aware decoders estimate which positions interact, from attention maps ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) or with a small trained predictor ( Ringel et al., 2026 ) .
Mean-field parallel decoding ( Zoabi et al., 2026 ) takes a training-free view based on an energy model.
Each masked position gets a commit score, a pairwise term penalizes committing two positions whose predictive distributions are similar, measured by the Jensen-Shannon divergence, and a few mean-field updates decide which positions to commit.

In this work, we tackle the question of what pairwise quantity should this energy use.
The quantity that matters is the effect of committing token j j on the confidence of position i i .
We call it the coupling Δ i ​ j \Delta_{ij} (Figure 1 ).
It can be positive, when j j makes i i less certain, or negative, when j j supports i i .
Two positions with similar distributions may not affect each other at all, and two positions with different distributions may depend strongly on each other, for example the digits of one number.

blocks.en:
The coupling can be measured with the model itself: reveal j j , run the model, and read the new confidence at i i .
Done naively, this costs one forward pass per candidate.

A probe only needs to recompute the current block.
The rest of the sequence reuses the keys and values from the step’s main forward pass.
This approximation is accurate (Pearson 0.96 0.96 to 0.97 0.97 with exact probes) and reduces the work of a probe from the whole sequence to the masked positions of one block.
We then run the probes inside the main forward pass of each step, so the model weights are read once for both.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Measured coupling. We define the pairwise term of parallel decoding as the change in log-margin caused by committing another token, including support as well as conflict. • Fused block-local probes. A probe recomputes only the masked positions of the current block against the keys and values of the main pass, and all probes run inside that same pass. This makes measuring the coupling cheap enough to pay off in wall-clock time. • A reading of the mean-field rule. As an interpretation, under an additive model of conditional margins the mean-field fixed point with measured coupling equals the sigmoid of each token’s expected margin given the others (Proposition 1 ), and a standard contraction condition guarantees a unique fixed point (Proposition 2 ). • Results. On LLaDA-8B, LLaDA-1.5, and Dream, measured coupling needs the fewest steps on every benchmark and has the shortest time per answer in most of them. Its accuracy is 1.1 points below mean-field decoding on average and ranges from 6.1 points lower to 1.8 points higher; the drop is significant on MATH for two of the three models, and the largest drops are on Dream HumanEval and LLaDA-1.5 MBPP.

blocks.en:
Appendix B isolates the pairwise term at a common threshold.
Our coupling needs clearly fewer steps than both the confidence-only rule and mean-field decoding, because it detects support: tokens that confirm each other are committed together.
Table 4 tests whether the measured pairs matter, or whether any added support would do.
Each control changes only the coupling of our method, on the same measured pairs, with all other settings fixed.
Shuffling the measured values across pairs keeps their distribution and breaks accuracy, by 36 points on GSM8K and 20 on MBPP.
A constant support bonus, tuned on held-out GSM8K questions, keeps accuracy and needs 44% to 46% more steps, and keeping the measured conflicts with a tuned constant support needs 53% to 72% more.
The gain therefore comes from knowing which pairs support each other.
The two signs work together: keeping only support collapses accuracy, and keeping only conflicts needs about as many steps as mean-field decoding.
Averaging the two directions where both are measured costs 2 to 3 points (significant on MBPP), so its direction carries some information.

blocks.en: 4.6 Probe fidelity and cost
blocks.zh: 4.6 勘探忠诚和费用

blocks.en:
Our probes agree closely with exact full-sequence probes.
During greedy decoding on GSM8K and HumanEval, the two couplings have a Pearson correlation of 0.96 to 0.97, and they agree in sign on 97% of the pairs with a clear effect ( | Δ i ​ j | > 0.5 |\Delta_{ij}|>0.5 ; Appendix A ).
About half of the candidate pairs are measured (51% on GSM8K, 55% on MBPP; the rest keep Δ i ​ j = 0 \Delta_{ij}=0 ), and 31% and 23% of probes are dropped because their token changed.
On LLaDA, at a similar step budget, a confidence threshold commits three to four times as many tokens that are overturned by the rest of their commit set (Appendix K ).
The probes are also cheap. Exact probes cost about nine forward passes per step, and a separate probe call about half a pass, mostly for reading the weights. Inside the main pass, a step costs 1.2 to 1.5 times a mean-field step, and our method needs 26% to 55% fewer steps.
A variant that learns the coupling from the decoder’s next step, with no probes, saves fewer steps (Appendix M ).

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Confidence thresholds ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , entropy bounds, and dilated schedules ( Ben-Hamu et al., 2025 ; Luxembourg et al., 2026 ) decide how many positions to commit at once.
Mean-field decoding adds a similarity penalty and a variational update ( Zoabi et al., 2026 ) .
DAWN and dependency-aware parallel decoding build a dependency graph from attention maps and choose an independent set ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) .
DEMASK trains a predictor of the total-variation effect of revealing a token and gives a guarantee on the joint error ( Ringel et al., 2026 ) ; our coupling is close to this quantity, and its predictor is not public.
AXON reveals supportive anchors on top of an existing decoder, approximating their value with attention ( Abu Ayoub et al., 2026 ) ; it could run on top of ours, and our probes measure a similar quantity directly.
PUNT tests independence with extra model calls and prunes every dependent token ( Azangulov et al., 2026 ) . Conditional influence is therefore not new; we add a training-free way to measure it online, with sign and direction, cheaply enough to coordinate parallel commits.
Other work verifies drafts with an autoregressive model or with the model itself ( Israel et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) , verifies drafted future steps ( Pan et al., 2026 ; Shlomi et al., 2026 ) , or remasks committed tokens ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ; these ideas are complementary to ours.
In speculative decoding, DCOCO trains a small module to score adjacent draft tokens ( Eisenstadt et al., 2026 ) ; we measure such dependencies without training.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en:
A step with probes costs 1.2 to 1.5 times a mean-field step (1.4 to 1.5 times with the cache), so the wall-clock gain is smaller than the step gain; a leaner probe kernel or cheaper coupling estimation would widen it.
The selected settings trade accuracy for speed on MATH and Dream HumanEval (Section 4.3 ).
Mutual support shows self-consistency, not correctness, so wrong tokens can reinforce each other. All answers have 256 tokens. With a key-value cache (Appendix D ), our GSM8K accuracy is below both baselines, and at block 20 we are slightly slower than mean-field decoding.

用探测器的一步成本为中场步骤的1.2到1.5倍(用缓存的1.4到1.5倍),因此相较于步骤增益的墙钟增益会更小;更精细的探测器内核或更便宜的接合估计会拓宽.

相互支持表现出自相矛盾,不正确,因此错误的道具可以相互强化. 所有答案都有256个符号. 由于键值缓存(Appendix D ),我们的GSM8K精度都低于两个基线,在第20项,我们比中场解码略慢.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: The pairwise term of parallel decoding can be measured instead of approximated, cheaply, by probes inside the main pass. The measured coupling shows support as well as conflict, and on three models it needs far fewer steps than mean-field decoding with no training, with and without a key-value cache. Shuffled couplings and a uniform bonus both lose this gain.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en:
A probe row holds one copy of the still-masked positions of the current block, with the probed candidate j j set to its proposal v j v_{j} and the other positions left masked.
In every layer, the main tokens and all probe rows go through the same normalization, projections, MLP, and output head in one batch.
Each probe query attends to the main keys and values of the same layer at every position it does not recompute, and to the keys and values of its own row at the positions it does; it never sees another probe row.
The main keys at the recomputed positions are masked out for the probe queries.
Rotary embeddings use each position’s index in the sequence, so a probe token sits where it would in the main pass.
Main tokens use the model’s usual bidirectional attention, so the main logits match a plain forward pass up to bfloat16 rounding.
blocks.zh:
被探测者j j 置入其提案 v j v_{j} 其它位置被蒙上面具。
在每层中,主符和所有探针行都经过同样的正常化,预测,MLP,输出头一批.
每一次探针查询都会在它不重算的每一个位置处理同一层的主键和值,并在它所做的位置处理自己行的键和值;它从不看到另一个探针行.
重算位置上的主要键被遮住用于探针查询.

blocks.en: Appendix G Where the MATH gap comes from
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en:
We paired every MATH problem between our method and mean-field decoding, using the saved answers of the main runs.
The gap is spread over all difficulty levels and subjects instead of concentrating on the hardest problems, where long and sensitive derivations would stress the additive model most.
Repetition loops occur at similar rates for both methods and explain at most 0.2 points of the gap.
On Dream, a stricter threshold narrows the gap: at τ = 0.99 \tau=0.99 our method comes within 0.8 points of mean-field decoding (37.1% against 37.9%, with K = 12 K=12 and with K = 20 K=20 ) with nearly 40% fewer steps, and the difference is not significant (Figure 4 ).
The gap therefore depends on the speed setting chosen on held-out data, and a stricter threshold reduces it at the cost of more steps.
blocks.zh:

差距分布在所有困难级别和课题上,而不是集中在最棘手的问题上,在那里,长期和敏感的衍生物最能强调添加剂模型。
重复循环在两种方法中都以相近的速率出现,并在差距的多0.2分处解释.
在"梦"上,一个更严格的门槛缩小了差距:在\\\\\\\"0.99"时,我们的方法在0.8点的中场解码范围内(37.1%对37.9%,而K=12K=12,而K=20K=20),步骤减少近40%,差异并不显著(图4).
因此,差距取决于根据搁置数据选择的速度设定,更严格的门槛以更多的步骤来降低差距。

blocks.en:
We decode 50 test questions of GSM8K and of MBPP with our method and, at every step, compute the commit set on the same state with other couplings (Table 9 ).
Block-local probes for all candidates change 4% of the decisions of exact probes, and measuring only the probed columns accounts for most of the rest.

blocks.en:
We then check each committed token against the rest of its commit set: we reveal the other tokens of the set, leave the token masked, and test whether its committed value is still the most likely one (Table 10 ).
End-of-text padding is excluded.
At the same number of steps, a confidence threshold commits three to four times as many overturned tokens as our method, and the gap is largest for small sets.
Slower decoders with 50% to 65% more steps are overturned slightly less often.

blocks.en: Appendix M Learned coupling from the next step
blocks.zh: 下一步总结经验的组合

blocks.en:
The decoder’s own next step contains information about the coupling.
After a set S S is committed, the next forward pass shows whether each remaining position changes its choice.
This gives an exact label for the event that committing that position together with S S would have changed the answer, at no extra cost.
We fit a logistic model of this event on simple features of position pairs (distance and side, similarity of the two predictions, whether the tokens match, and the uncertainty at i i ), by ridge-regularized Newton steps, online and without training data, and commit positions whose predicted error probability is below a risk level ρ \rho .
blocks.zh:
解码器本身的下一步包含接合信息.
在一组 S S 承诺后,下一个前传显示每个剩余位置是否改变其选择.
这为不增加费用地与S S一起执行这一职位会改变答案的事件提供了确切的标签。
由山脊规范化的牛顿阶梯、在线和无训练数据, 并承担其预计出错概率低于风险水平的姿势。

blocks.en:
This variant needs no extra forward passes and is useful on its own.
With ρ \rho tuned on GSM8K training questions, it uses fewer steps than mean-field decoding on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MBPP, with accuracy within 1.4 points.
Its predicted flip rates match the observed rates within a few points for every committed-set size. This calibration is about flips, and Appendix J tests the additive margins directly.
Its labels come only from positions that were not committed, so they rarely cover confident tokens.
Probes reach those tokens directly, which explains the larger savings of measured coupling.
blocks.zh:
这种变体不需要额外的前行通行证,而且本身有用.
使用 $ \rho 调用 GSM8K 训练问题, 它在 GSM8K , HumanEval 和 MBPP 上使用的步骤比中场解码少, 精确度在 1. 4 分以内.
它的预测翻转率与每个承诺设定的大小在几分内观察到的速率相匹配. 这种校正涉及翻转,附录J直接测试了添加剂边.
其标签仅出自未承诺的姿势,因此很少覆盖有自信的道具.
探测器直接到达这些标志,这解释了测量耦合所节省的更多.
